measurement_basis: focused claim, ECI projection, event-sequence, and briefing regression suites
not_measured: future production event volume or failure distribution

outcome.authorization_and_conflict_rejections: Typed rejection event recorded before publication; claims store remains unchanged.
outcome.generation_fence: A generation-fenced rejection does not append a separate event or advance the Store generation.
outcome.privacy: Projection exposes failure category/code and scope kind; free-text reason and checkout path are omitted.
outcome.projection: lease.acquisition-rejected is represented in bounded session_activity.claim_coordination with objective links when present.
outcome.request_replay: Repeated identical rejected request does not duplicate its event.

request.test_command: python3 -m pytest tests/test_environment.py::ClaimTests tests/test_capability_intelligence.py tests/test_claim_generation_cas.py tests/test_briefing.py tests/test_event_sequence_retry.py -q

observation.source_interface: MNCS Environment Session event stream and environmental-capability projection

related_work.work_intent_goal: Improve MNCS's ability to observe, interpret, and improve how the environment serves agents working within MNCS.
